vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: jimeng-prompter
Version: 1.1.0

The jimeng-prompter skill is a structured prompt engineering framework designed to assist users in creating high-quality video prompts for the Jimeng (Seedance 2.0) platform. It employs a multi-phase instructional approach (Director and Prompt Crafter roles) to guide users through creative conceptualization and technical output. The content consists entirely of benign markdown instructions and templates, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only video prompt helper with no evidence of code execution, credential access, data collection, persistence, or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe a prompt-engineering workflow for Jimeng/Seedance video generation: asking the user about intent, confirming a plan, then producing shot tables, negative prompts, and concept-art prompts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The visible instructions are scoped to conversation flow and text generation, including limits such as one question at a time, a five-round cap, and waiting for user confirmation before producing final prompts.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, no required binaries, no environment variables, and no code files; the README only documents normal OpenClaw skill installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request filesystem access, shell commands, network access, credentials, or local configuration; its authority is proportionate to an instruction-only prompt-generation skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background agent behavior, privileged access, or autonomous activity outside the user conversation is shown in the provided artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears safe to install for generating Jimeng/Seedance video prompts. As with any creative AI workflow, review generated prompts and media manually before posting publicly, and follow the video platform’s copyright and content rules.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: No artifact-backed evidence of unsafe tool use, unexpected execution, deceptive control, or rogue behavior.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, account access, or elevated permissions are requested.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No persistent memory, broad indexing, inter-agent messaging, or sensitive data handling is shown.
